facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Ms. Clara had many small boxes. She started to unpack. Emma helped with books. Ben helped with clothes. They sang a small song. The kitchen smelled like cookies. Everyone smiled together. A kind nanny came home.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Ms. Clara settled into her small room at the top of the stairs. Emma and Ben helped her carry her boxes one by one, their tiny arms strong with excitement. Inside the boxes were soft sweaters, story books, a polished tea cup, and a small wooden bird. "Where shall this go?" Ben asked, holding up the wooden bird. "On the windowsill, please," Ms. Clara said with a wink. Their hands worked together, and laughter filled the air. A kind nanny came home, and the cottage felt new. Sunlight streamed through the curtains as if the house itself were smiling. It was no longer just a building. It was becoming a real home.
